name: one leg front lever
description: A front lever hold with one leg straight and the other tucked. It bridges the gap between the advanced tuck and the straddle.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and pull your shoulder blades down.
Raise your body into an advanced tuck with a flat back.
Extend one leg straight out in line with your torso and keep the other knee bent.
Squeeze your glutes so your hips stay level with your shoulders.
Hold, then lower with control and switch the straight leg next set.
